cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Get away from the overcrowded airboat tours and come witness the magic of Central Florida's nature scene up close. Led by a local award-winning wildlife photographer and ecologist, this intimate guided hike immerses you in the wild beauty of Florida’s natural landscapes. This area is known for consistent wildlife activity, and sightings of alligators and wading birds are common on most hikes. Journey through forests, swamps, and riverside trails while observing native wildlife and learning how each species plays a role in Florida’s delicate ecosystems. Along the way, your guide will capture professional photos of you and the wildlife you encounter, providing a stunning visual story of your experience to take home and treasure.
